en.title: Air Materiel Command Opinion Concerning Flying Discs (Twining Memo)
en.executive_summary: Official classified letter from Lt. Gen. Nathan Twining to Brig. Gen. George Schulgen concluding that 'the phenomenon reported is something real and not visionary or fictitious'.

zh_hk.title: 美國陸軍航空軍航空物資司令部特文寧備忘錄（Twining Memo）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 航空物資司令部司令特文寧中將致陸航情報部之官方機密函件，首度以官方軍事結論確立『所通報之現象實屬真實存在，絕非虛構或幻覺』，奠定軍方後續專項調查之起點。

en.title: Pentagon Press Conference on Washington D.C. Radar-Visual Incursions
en.executive_summary: Major General John Samford, Director of Air Force Intelligence, hosts the largest military press conference since WWII following consecutive radar-visual incursions over restricted D.C. airspace.

zh_hk.title: 五角大廈就華盛頓特區禁區空域雷達與視覺目擊入侵召開之官方聯合記者會
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國空軍情報總監山姆福德少將於五角大廈主持自二戰結束以來規模最大之官方記者會，回應華盛頓國家禁飛區連續多日遭多架異常雷達追蹤目標入侵之防衛應變處置。

sources.label: USAF Official Historical Press Release Archive

agencies: House Committee on Science and Astronautics

en.title: Symposium on Unidentified Flying Objects: Hearings Before the Committee on Science and Astronautics
en.executive_summary: Official congressional symposium transcript featuring scientific testimonies and physics assessments regarding unidentified aerial phenomena by leading astronomers and atmospheric scientists.

zh_hk.title: 美國眾議院科學及航天委員會：不明飛行物科學研討聽證會正式出版公報
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國會政府出版局 (GPO) 印行之科學聽證實錄，邀集包括海尼克博士與卡爾·薩根等頂尖大氣物理學家及天文學者，就各類異常飛行特徵與大氣光學數據提出國會證詞。

en.title: DIA Defense Intelligence Assessment: Joint Military Intercept over Tehran
en.executive_summary: Declassified intelligence evaluation (IIR 6 846 0140 76) confirming dual F-4 radar lock-ons, simultaneous avionics failures, and anomalous electronic countermeasure capabilities during intercept.

zh_hk.title: 美國國防情報局 (DIA) 情報評估報告：德黑蘭領空雙戰機聯合雷達攔截事件
zh_hk.executive_summary: 國防情報局解密情資檔案（編號 IIR 6 846 0140 76），向五角大廈聯參會及白宮呈報。報告證實兩架 F-4 戰鬥機目擊及雷達鎖定目標期間，遭遇同步航電失靈與異常電子反制現象。

sources.label: Defense Intelligence Agency FOIA Electronic Reading Room

en.title: Unexplained Lights: Official Memorandum from Deputy Base Commander to UK Ministry of Defence
en.executive_summary: Lt. Col. Charles I. Halt's official memorandum detailing consecutive nocturnal incursions, ground radiation readings, and broken tree canopies at RAF Bentwaters / Woodbridge.

zh_hk.title: 英國國防部倫道森森林事件霍爾特副基地司令官方通報備忘錄（Halt Memo）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國空軍駐英基地副司令霍爾特中校呈交予英國國防部之法定報告，詳載官兵連續夜間遭遇異常發光物、現場所錄得之 Beta/Gamma 輻射異常讀數與物理撞擊痕跡。

en.title: Official Report on the Night of the UFOs: Aerospace Defense Command Interception Logs
en.executive_summary: Declassified report signed by the Brazilian Air Force Minister following nationwide radar tracks and scramble operations involving Mirage III and F-5E fighter jets.

zh_hk.title: 巴西航空部空軍司令部「幽浮之夜」防空攔截作戰官方解密報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 巴西空軍部長於全國電視記者會公開之作戰報告。記錄防空司令部（COMDA）緊急出動幻象三型與 F-5E 戰機，於多個地面雷達站協同追蹤下進行多輪攔截之完整軍事日誌。

sources.label: Arquivo Nacional do Brasil - Fundo Força Aérea Brasileira

agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

en.title: Preliminary Assessment: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (ODNI Public Report)
en.executive_summary: Landmark interagency declassified report analyzing 144 military aviator sightings between 2004 and 2021, concluding that most UAP represent physical objects.

zh_hk.title: 美國國家情報總監辦公室 (ODNI)：未知空中現象初階評估報告
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國情報界跨部會向國會提交之歷史性解密報告。深入剖析 2004 至 2021 年間 144 起軍事飛行員遭遇案例，正式確認絕大多數通報目標均為具備實體物理特徵之物體。

agencies: House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence

en.title: Open Hearing on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
en.executive_summary: First open congressional hearing on unidentified aerial phenomena in more than 50 years, featuring testimony from Under Secretary of Defense Ronald Moultrie and Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott Bray.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院情報特別委員會反恐情報小組 UAP 歷史性公開聽證會官方紀錄
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部次長 Ronald Moultrie 與海軍情報副局長 Scott Bray 出席作證，為美國國會超過半世紀以來首次召開之 UAP 公開聽證會官方出版紀錄。

en.title: UAP Disclosure Act of 2023 (Schumer-Rounds Amendment SA 797 to S. 2226)
en.executive_summary: Bipartisan amendment led by Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer proposing a 9-member independent Presidential Review Board to declassify legacy defense materials and recover non-human intelligence technologies.

zh_hk.title: 2023 年未知異常現象披露法案（舒默－朗茲 UAPDA 跨黨派修正案 SA 797）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 參議院多數黨領袖舒默聯同參議員朗茲提出之里程碑修正案，擬設立由 9 名獨立專家組成、直屬總統且具備傳召取證權之審查委員會，推動跨部會積存之歷史機密檔案與潛在地外科技物證有序向公眾解密。

agencies: House Committee on Oversight and Accountability

en.title: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Implications on National Security, Public Safety, and Government Transparency
en.executive_summary: Official printed transcript of the landmark House Oversight sworn hearing featuring testimony from former intelligence officer David Grusch and former naval aviators.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院監督及問責委員會 UAP 宣誓聽證會正式出版紀錄（含證人 Grusch 證詞）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國政府出版局 (GPO) 正式印行之法定公報。記錄前情報官員與海軍飛行員就未公開國防計畫、飛行安全及異常航天目標遭遇事件進行之宣誓證詞。

en.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records: AARO Records Tracking
en.executive_summary: Notice of a modified system of records to include collection and maintenance of anomalous unidentified sightings reported by service members.

zh_hk.title: 1974 年隱私法案；系統記錄通告 (SORN)：AARO 異常個案追蹤記錄庫修訂
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部正式修訂法定系統記錄庫，將現役軍職人員向 AARO 通報之異常飛行與跨領域不明目標目擊數據，納入聯邦私隱法規保護與長期安全存檔機制。

en.title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024 (Public Law 118-31)
en.executive_summary: Enacted federal defense law containing Subtitle C (Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena Disclosure), mandating DoD/AARO centralized records collection, reporting mechanisms, and whistleblower protections.

zh_hk.title: 2024 財政年度國防授權法案（聯邦公法第 118-31 號）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國總統簽署生效之聯邦國防法案，包含丙部（未知異常現象披露）專項條款，明令國防部全領域異常解析辦公室 (AARO) 實施中央檔案集中管理、確立軍民通報機制及吹哨者法定義務保障。

en.title: Servicemember Quality of Life Improvement and National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2025
en.executive_summary: House-passed defense authorization bill expanding AARO oversight, mandating ongoing public reporting timelines, and tightening inter-agency anomaly intelligence data sharing.

zh_hk.title: 現役軍人生活質素改善暨 2025 財政年度國防授權法案（眾議院通過版本）
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國眾議院審議通過之國防預算法案，進一步擴大國會對 AARO 的法定監督職責，強制收緊跨情報機關與國防設施異常空情數據的共享通報時限，並加強公眾定期報告之問責性。

en.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposals, Submissions, and Approvals: All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO)
en.executive_summary: Department of Defense notice regarding public information collection, secure reporting procedures, and data repository integrity under Title 10 provisions.

zh_hk.title: 擬議資訊收集暨公眾諮詢公告：全領域異常解析辦公室 (AARO) 專項業務
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國國防部正式發布之聯邦公報，依據《美國法典》第 10 卷授權，針對設立公眾通報途徑、保障異常現象數據安全存檔與資訊徵詢機制徵集公眾意見。

agencies: House Committee on Oversight and Accountability

en.title: Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena: Exposing the Truth (House Oversight Hearing)
en.executive_summary: Joint subcommittee hearing examining federal secrecy, undisclosed Special Access Programs (SAP), oceanographic UAP detections, and the Immaculate Constellation whistleblower disclosure.

zh_hk.title: 眾議院監督委員會：未知異常現象——揭開真相聯合宣誓聽證會
zh_hk.executive_summary: 美國眾議院兩小組聯合召開之法定宣誓聽證會。退役海軍少將 Gallaudet、前國防部官員 Elizondo 及調查記者出席，揭露未向國會報告之特別存取計畫 (USAP)『無瑕星座』(Immaculate Constellation) 與海洋水下異常探測紀錄。
